There is no generic "post" click handler in XenForo, and the nearest candidate ("switch") is built to swap a label in place -- but ending an impersonation changes the visitor identity, so the nav, the avatar, the permissions and the CSRF token are all stale afterwards. A plain browser POST answered with a redirect re-renders everything.
